content:
Maya (Sales): Aurora.ai wants a hosted POC next Monday. They need a short demo burst + a longer smoke test. Can infra spin up an ephemeral key + temporary quota?
Ike (Infra): Numbers and windows?
Maya (Sales): Peak 330 rps for 12m (demo), then 55 rps sustained for 3h. Streaming SSE from their backend.
Jonah (Platform): We can provide a scoped ephemeral key and a burst window. Streaming needs higher concurrent connections; we'll raise per-key conn limit.
Sofia (Security): Requirements: server-side calls from fixed egress IPs, TTL <= 72h (48h preferred), scope limited to generation only, redact logs, no raw payload export. Need SOC contact.
Maya (Sales): They can egress from 45.120.200.0/24. TTL 48h. SOC: security@aurora.ai.
Ike (Infra): I'll create override: burst=330 rps window=12m, sustained=55 rps thereafter. Increase conn_limit to 140 for this key. Need ticket with IPs/windows.
Tess (SRE): I'll add an ad-hoc dashboard and alert to #eng-oncall if error_rate > 2% or p95 > 1.5s. Also watch SSE connection churn.
Jonah (Platform): Key scope locked to generation:invoke. Disable embeddings/rerank. Token traces off. Logs redaction on.
Maya (Sales): Demo window: 2028-09-11T14:00:00Z - 2028-09-11T17:00:00Z (burst 14:30-14:42Z). Ticket REDWOOD-POC-644 created.
(deploy-bot 14m later): Ephemeral key created: id ephem_h5k2q, scope=generation:invoke, expires in 48h, IP allowlist applied. See REDWOOD-POC-644.
Ike (Infra): Sample curl for streaming (replace <KEY>):
```
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"rw-gpt-7b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"user 42 recs"}],"stream":true}'
```
Maya (Sales): Sending to Aurora. They asked: if they keep 55 rps steady for a month, rough cost?
Jonah (Platform): Ballpark ~ $1.6k/mo for continuous 55 rps on rw-gpt-7b (current token assumptions). I'll open a pricing note.
Aurora (customer via email): Smoke test hit ~310 rps streaming, no errors. Key works.
Tess (SRE): Monitoring live. If sustained >55 rps outside the demo we will route traffic to a lower-cost model automatically and notify in REDWOOD-POC-644.
Sofia (Security): Confirmed limited logs retained for 7 days. Key will auto-expire.
Maya (Sales): Thanks team :thumbsup:
